context: Tests whether the agent picks the right Koog 1.3 API for history compression (a writeSession-locked replaceHistoryWithTLDR call at a deliberate boundary) rather than reaching for an external string-manipulation approach or compressing on every node.

checklist.name: Calls replaceHistoryWithTLDR inside llm.writeSession
checklist.description: Invokes replaceHistoryWithTLDR() (or an equivalent HistoryCompressionStrategy invocation) inside llm.writeSession { ... }. Does NOT manipulate the prompt history outside a write session — the session lock is mandatory for safe mutation

checklist.name: Compresses only at the boundary node, not every node
checklist.description: The compression call appears in exactly one place — the boundary node the developer identified. Does NOT add per-node compression that would summarize away each step's findings

checklist.name: Picks WholeHistory or equivalent TL;DR strategy
checklist.description: Uses HistoryCompressionStrategy.WholeHistory (the TL;DR-everything variant) or replaceHistoryWithTLDR which maps to it. Not FromLastNMessages (which keeps a sliding window — different semantics) or NoCompression

checklist.name: Does not introduce LongTermMemory
checklist.description: Does not install the LongTermMemory feature — the developer's need is within-run compression, not cross-session memory. Adding LongTermMemory would be wrong scope and an unjustified dependency

checklist.name: Compression happens before the next LLM call in drafting
checklist.description: The replaceHistoryWithTLDR happens before the drafting phase's first nodeLLMRequest, so the drafting LLM sees the summarized history. Calling it after the drafting node would waste the call
